description: This file defines a report for inactive sales items in an ERP system, including functions to generate report columns, fetch data, and retrieve related sales, territory, and item information.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate report columns and data based on filters.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the structure and fields of the report columns.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches and compiles report data based on filters, including filtering by last order date.

methods.name: get_sales_details
methods.description: Retrieves sales data with last order date and days since last order, based on filters.

methods.name: get_territories
methods.description: Fetches territory information, optionally filtered by specific territory.

methods.name: get_items
methods.description: Retrieves item information, filtered by item group or item code.
